title: O Level / IGCSE
audience: Students sitting Cambridge O Level 2210 or IGCSE 0478 Computer Science.
summary: The whole course in two papers: how computers store, move and process data, then how to design, trace and write algorithms in pseudocode.

title: AS Level
audience: First-year A Level students taking the AS papers of Cambridge 9618.
summary: Theory fundamentals and the first serious programming paper: abstract data types, structured pseudocode and the software development cycle.
papers: Paper 2 | Fundamental Problem-solving and Programming Skills

title: A2 Level
audience: Second-year students completing the full Cambridge 9618 qualification.
summary: Advanced theory and the practical paper: floating point, virtual machines, recursion, OOP, exceptions and the classic algorithms.

title: Full A Level
audience: Students taking all four 9618 papers in one series, including private candidates.
summary: AS and A2 together. Plan the four papers as two tracks: theory (Papers 1 and 3) and problem-solving and programming (Papers 2 and 4).
